Google Maps révolutionne sa navigation, le moteur hybride chinois de Renault et Gemini qui arrive dans les voitures — Récap' Survoltés

May 15, 2026 Rédaction Survoltés (Frandroid) Google Maps, Gemini AI, Android Auto, immersive navigation, 3D navigation, Renault, hybrid engine, automotive tech
Read the source article

Quick summary

Google unveiled at Android Show 2026 the most ambitious Maps redesign in a decade, featuring 3D immersive navigation, a natural-voice assistant powered by Gemini, and live lane guidance for Google Built-in vehicles — though France will get these features later with no set date.

Key takeaways

  • Google Maps' biggest redesign in 10 years was announced at Android Show 2026: 3D immersive navigation, a more natural voice, and Ask Maps powered by Gemini AI.
  • Vehicles with Google Built-in will benefit from live lane guidance, moving Maps deeper into the in-car experience.
  • France is notably excluded from the initial rollout with no confirmed availability date.
  • Android Auto also received a complete overhaul with adaptive interface, interactive widgets, 3D compatibility, and Gemini replacing Google Assistant.
  • The article is a weekly automotive/tech recap; additional items cover Renault's Chinese V6 hybrid engine and Anker/Bluetti solar battery systems.
